notes: Texas provides THREE comprehensive PDFs organized by school level (Elementary K-5, Middle School 6-8, High School 9-12), not a single K-12 document. These are the official Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS) for Science, Chapter 112 of the Texas Administrative Code. All documents updated August 2024.
issues_encountered: No single comprehensive K-12 document available - organized into three subchapters by school level
document_organization: Texas TEKS for Science are organized in Chapter 112 of the Texas Administrative Code (19 TAC Chapter 112). Subchapter A covers Elementary (K-5), Subchapter B covers Middle School (6-8), and Subchapter C covers High School (9-12). Content is organized into recurring strands.
high_school_courses: Texas high school science includes: Biology, Chemistry, Integrated Physics and Chemistry (IPC), Physics, Environmental Science, Earth Systems Science, Aquatic Science, and Astronomy. TEKS adopted November 2020 for Biology, Chemistry, IPC, and Physics.
recent_updates: Elementary and Middle School TEKS updated August 2024. High School courses (Biology, Chemistry, IPC, Physics) adopted November 2020.
additional_resources: Texas provides extensive support materials including TEKS Guide, TEKS in Focus documents, vertical alignment documents by discipline (Biology, Chemistry, Earth & Space, Physics), and engineering design challenge guides for each grade K-5.
